name: Tell Me Lies
description: When Lucy Albright and Stephen DeMarco meet at college, they are at that formative age when seemingly mundane choices lead the way to irrevocable consequences. They quickly fall into an addictive entanglement that will permanently alter not only their lives, but the lives of everyone around them.

videos.title: Lightning Strikes
videos.overview: Lucy starts her freshman year at Baird College, where an unexpected turn of events during Welcome Week flips her life upside down.

videos.title: Hot-Blooded
videos.overview: Lucy struggles with the aftermath of Welcome Week and goes on her first date with Stephen.

videos.title: We Don't Touch, We Collide
videos.overview: Pressure on Wrigley intensifies, bleeding into his relationship with Pippa. Lucy and Stephen discuss exclusivity.

videos.title: Take Off Your Pants and Jacket
videos.overview: Bree attempts to lose her virginity. Stephen goes to New York City for the weekend, while Lucy tries to figure out where their relationship stands.

videos.title: Merry F*cking Christmas
videos.overview: Lucy and Stephen go home for winter break and deal with family tension. Meanwhile, Lucy uncovers a secret.

videos.title: And I'm Sorry If I Dissed You
videos.overview: Lucy confronts Stephen about what she found at Macy's memorial.

videos.title: Castle on a Cloud
videos.overview: The group goes to Evan's lake house to celebrate his 21st birthday.

videos.title: Don't Go Wasting Your Emotion
videos.overview: Pippa has complicated feelings after Wrigley meets her dad. Lucy makes a decision to protect Stephen.

videos.title: Sugar, We're Going Down Swinging
videos.overview: Things between Wrigley and Drew come to a head. Lucy is forced to confront her past.

videos.title: Bedrooms of Our Friends
videos.overview: Lucy and Stephen go to the final party of the semester and everything changes.

videos.title: You Got a Reaction, Didn't You?
videos.overview: Lucy's back at Baird College for sophomore year, ready to start fresh and leave past mistakes behind her.

videos.title: I Shall Now Perform a 180 Flip-Flop
videos.overview: Bree's birthday takes an unexpected turn. Lucy's excited to focus on someone new.

videos.title: I Can See Right Through Myself
videos.overview: Stephen baits Lucy as she attempts to rid herself of him once and for all. Wrigley and Pippa finally talk.

videos.title: Just Stable Children
videos.overview: As the LSAT looms, Stephen's anxiety grows. Wrigley and Evan have a guy's night out.

videos.title: Evil, Ornery, Scandalous, and Evil
videos.overview: Lydia and Stephen's sister, Sadie, both visit campus for Halloween. Lucy and Pippa learn something unsettling.

videos.title: Do Your Dirty Words Come Out to Play?
videos.overview: When a snowed-in campus forces everyone to Evan's for Thanksgiving, tensions run high.

videos.title: I'm Not Drowning Fast Enough
videos.overview: Lucy and Bree attend a professor's Christmas party. Lucy makes a rash decision that affects Pippa.

videos.title: Don't Struggle Like That, or I Will Only Love You More
videos.overview: End of semester Christmas celebrations change everything for everyone – again.

videos.title: You F*cked It, Friend
videos.overview: Back at Baird College for spring semester, Lucy and Stephen promise things will be different this time.

videos.title: We Can't Help It If We Are a Problem
videos.overview: Bree encounters an unexpected reunion. Stephen gives Lucy an ultimatum.

videos.title: Repent
videos.overview: The Puswas attend an Apres-Ski frat party. Lucy tries to switch her focus away from Stephen.

videos.title: Fix Me Up, Girl
videos.overview: A surprising setback sends Diana back into Stephen's orbit. Lucy seeks advice from an unlikely person.

videos.title: I'd Like to Hold Her Head Under Water
videos.overview: Gossip spirals around Lucy at a pool party. Bree seeks answers from her childhood.

videos.title: I Don't Cry When I'm Sad Anymore
videos.overview: Everyone goes goth for Valentine’s Day. Stephen introduces a new friend.

videos.title: I Will Promise Not to Sting
videos.overview: Relationships are tested at Bree's photography exhibition. Lucy devises a plan to finally put rumors to rest.

videos.title: Are You Happy Now, That I'm on My Knees?
videos.overview: A scandal erupts at Baird College. When shocking truths come to light, consequences follow for everyone.
